title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterAsset
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterAsset. A water asset is a physical entity used in the process of transporting, treating, storing and distributing water. Subclass of geo:Feature, saref:FeatureOfInterest and s4syst:System per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported classes, not separately modeled here). This is the root of the water-asset hierarchy: SinkAsset, SourceAsset, StorageAsset, TransportAsset and WaterDevice (and all of their leaf subclasses) inherit from this class. It has no own OWL properties beyond the base id/type/dateCreated/dateModified/source/dataProvider pattern plus location (inherited via geo:hasGeometry); this base+location pattern is documented here and not repeated on the subclass models.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterAsset'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.
